verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships a documented, public MCP server (email-mcp) that lets AI-native users drive inbox/calendar actions—summarize, draft, send, schedule—directly from Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools, which is a real programmatic surface for agentic use. However, probes confirm there is no traditional REST/OpenAPI-documented public API (llms.txt and openapi.json endpoints all 404), so developers outside the MCP/AI-assistant flow have no documented way to integrate. Missing for 10: a general-purpose REST/GraphQL API with OpenAPI spec, and any independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability.
